posts.author: Sinacs
posts.body:
Hello.
Is there a plugin that allows for an XP-style "Crossfade" transition? Instead of going through a solid black screen, the current map screen should smoothly fade directly into the destination map screen, blending the two visuals during the transition.
(My English isn't perfect, so I wrote this with the help of Gemini.)
Thank you in advance to anyone who can help with this.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: If you can't find a plugin, I suppose what you can do is take screenshots of every exit and the location they lead to, display both via the show picture command, transfer without fade, and then do the cross fade yourself with the move picture commands. (Pretty unwieldy solution, but still)

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
So the problem with SG's solution is that it's not very flexible.
Like, don't get me wrong, it works, but it's cumbersome if you set it up manually every time. Not only do you have to take the screenshots yourself, but then set up the cross fade event.
If you ever edit the maps, you will have to redo that whole set up.
Some parts of the process likely can be automated, though I don't know the scripts to set it up, but it should be possible if you label the screenshots with clear names or values, you can use a script call to show a picture based on a variable. Each transfer would then just set the variable value then run a common event.
This likely can be further automated since there should be a script for taking and then displaying a screenshot since the engine already does this for different scenes.
That said, I am pretty sure I saw a plugin that may not be exactly like this but at least offers something similar.
Some quick searching, there is one from Chaucer which costs, but I trust his code to be high quality.
Rosedale Transition Effects [MV-MZ] by chaucer
Create Unique transition/dissolve effects on everything!
chaucer.itch.io
I just discovered this one in my search, which looks fun:
GitHub - Serena1432/SmoothTransition: A plugin handling smooth transtions for any RPG Maker MV/MZ games.
A plugin handling smooth transtions for any RPG Maker MV/MZ games. - Serena1432/SmoothTransition
github.com
Here are some others:
GitHub - HashakGik/Transitions-RMMV
Contribute to HashakGik/Transitions-RMMV development by creating an account on GitHub.
github.com
There is also one by Hakuen that has exactly what you are looking for...but it's unfortunately for MZ
You can just try various search terms in your favorite search engine for something like "rpg maker mv" "map transition" "map transfer" "transition effects" "plugin" or other similar terms.
